item.title: Kim Min-seok's Unexpectedly Narrow Win in Chungcheong, "Home Turf" of Chung Cheong-rae... "A Result Showing Demands for Change and Innovation" (김민석, ‘정청래 고향’ 충청서 예상 밖 박빙 승…“변화·혁신 요구 보여준 결과”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok, a candidate for leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, took first place in the first national tour primary held in the Chungcheong region ahead of the Aug. 17 national convention, beating candidate Chung Cheong-rae by 303 votes (0.44 percentage points). Candidate Kim assessed the outcome as "a result of party members and the public showing their expectations for change and demands for innovation." (김민석 더불어민주당 대표 후보가 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 충청권에서 열린 첫 전국순회경선에서 정청래 후보를 303표(0.44%포인트) 차로 제치고 1위를 차지했다. 김 후보는 “변화에 대한 기대, 혁신에 대한 요구를 당원과 국민께서 보여주신 결과”라고 자평했다.)

The party's election management committee announced on the 1st that in the Chungcheong region (Daejeon, Sejong, South Chungcheong, North Chungcheong) tour primary for the party leadership election, Kim placed first with 30,632 votes (45.06%). Chung came in second with 30,329 votes (44.61%), and Song Young-gil placed third with 7,027 votes (10.34%). ( 민주당 선거관리위원회는 1일 전당대회 당대표 선거 충청권(대전·세종·충남·충북) 순회경선 결과 김 후보가 3만632표(45.06%)를 얻어 1위에 올랐다고 밝혔다. 정 후보는 3만329표(44.61%)를 얻어 2위를, 송영길 후보는 7027표(10.34%)를 얻어 3위를 기록했다.)

By region, Kim led Chung in South Chungcheong (45.65%) and North Chungcheong (47.39%), where Chung received 43.28% and 41.86%, respectively. However, in Daejeon and Sejong, Kim trailed Chung, receiving 42.71% and 40.68%, respectively, compared to Chung's 48.23% and 50.28%. ( 지역별로 보면 김 후보는 충남(45.65%)과 충북(47.39%)에서 정 후보(충남 43.28%· 충북 41.86%)에 앞섰다. 다만 대전과 세종에선 각각 42.71%, 40.68%의 득표율로 정 후보(대전 48.23%·세종 50.28%)에 뒤졌다.)

The online voter turnout among eligible party members in the Chungcheong region was tallied at 41.5% (67,988 out of 163,846 eligible voters). This was higher than the average online turnout of 26.5% among eligible party members in the Chungcheong region during last year's national convention, which was held over a single day. Earlier, the Democratic Party conducted online voting for eligible party members in Chungcheong from the 28th to the 29th of last month, and from the 30th to the 31st, it conducted automated response system (ARS) voting for eligible party members who did not vote online. ( 이번 충청권 권리당원 온라인 투표율은 41.5%(선거인 16만3846명 중 6만7988명 투표)로 집계됐다. 하루 동안 실시됐던 지난해 전당대회 충청권 권리당원 온라인 투표율(평균 26.5%)보다 높았다. 앞서 민주당은 지난달 28일∼29일 충청권 권리당원 온라인 투표를, 30일∼31일은 온라인 투표를 하지 않은 권리당원을 대상으로 자동응답(ARS) 투표를 진행했다.)

Kim Says Result "Exceeded Expectations"... Among Winning Candidates for Supreme Council, 3 Pro-Lee, 2 Pro-Chung ( 김 “기대 이상” 자평…최고위원 당선권엔 친명 3, 친청 2)

After the tour primary results were announced, Kim met with reporters and assessed the outcome as "beyond expectations." He cited as the reason that Chungcheong is "a region with ties to candidate Chung, and a region he had been preparing for a long time, so there was no special strategy we could genuinely employ organizationally," adding, "It was never going to be an easy region from the start." ( 김 후보는 순회경선 결과가 발표된 뒤 기자들을 만나 “기대 이상”의 결과라고 자평했다. 그는 그 이유로 충청이 “정 후보의 연고지이고 (정 후보가) 오래 전부터 준비해 온 지역이라, 조직적으로 사실 대응할 수 있었던 특별한 전략이 없었다”며 “처음부터 쉽지 않은 지역이었다”고 했다.)

Candidate Chung also assessed his performance, saying, "Considering that I've been beaten down and attacked by a ratio of 2-to-1, 3-to-1, 4-to-1, and 5-to-1, this is a very good result." Given that recent opinion polls showed him ahead of Kim in 'public sentiment' but behind in 'party sentiment,' his remarks appear to reflect an interpretation that even a razor-thin margin is not a bad outcome. ( 정 후보도 “2대 1, 3대 1, 4대 1, 5대 1로 저를 두들겨 패고 공격하고, 지금까지 당해온 걸 생각하면 매우 훌륭한 성과”라고 자평했다. 최근 여러 여론조사에서 ‘민심’에서는 김 후보에 앞서지만 ‘당심’에서는 김 후보에 뒤처지는 결과가 나왔던 만큼, 박빙의 결과도 나쁘지 않다는 해석을 내놓은 것으로 보인다. )

Candidate Song said, "I think I managed a minimum level of defense. The overall outcome depends on the final Honam and Seoul metropolitan area (tour primaries) with over a million votes, so I will do my best to engineer a turnaround there." ( 송 후보는 “최소한의 방어는 했다고 생각한다. 전체 내용은 1백만 표 이상의 마지막 호남·수도권(순회경선)에 달려 있기에 여기서 반전을 이루기 위해 최선을 다하겠다”는 소감을 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, in the Chungcheong tour primary for Supreme Council members held that day, the vote totals were as follows: Choe Min-hee (30,384 votes, 22.35%), Park Seon-won (22,721 votes, 16.71%), Han Min-su (19,222 votes, 14.14%), Seo Mi-hwa (18,517 votes, 13.62%), Kim Yong (17,045 votes, 12.54%), Lee Seong-yun (14,838 votes, 10.91%), Im Mi-ae (8,226 votes, 6.05%), and Kim Yeong-ho (5,023 votes, 3.69%). Among the top five within the winning range, three candidates affiliated with the 'pro-Lee Jae-myung faction' (Park Seon-won, Seo Mi-hwa, Kim Yong) and two affiliated with the 'pro-Chung Cheong-rae faction' (Choe Min-hee, Han Min-su) made the cut. ( 한편 이날 충청 순회경선 최고위원 선거에서는 최민희(3만384표·22.35%), 박선원(2만2721표·16.71%), 한민수(1만9222표·14.14%), 서미화(1만8517표·13.62%), 김용(1만7045표·12.54%), 이성윤(1만4838표·10.91%), 임미애(8226표·6.05%), 김영호(5023표·3.69%) 후보 순으로 표를 얻었다. 당선권인 1∼5위에는 ‘친명계(친이재명계)’ 후보 3명(박선원·서미화·김용)과 ‘친청계(친정청래계)’ 후보 2명(최민희·한민수)이 들게 됐다.)

Sharp Exchanges at Joint Rallies... "Self-Serving Politics" vs. "One Should Have a Sense of Shame" (합동연설회서 날 선 공방도…“자기 정치” vs “사람이 염치가 있어야”)

Ahead of announcing the tour primary results, the Democratic Party held three joint candidate rallies by region in South Chungcheong, North Chungcheong, and Daejeon·Sejong. At the rallies, the election structure of 'Chung Cheong-rae vs. Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil' was clearly evident. Kim and Song, along with Supreme Council candidates aligned with them, criticized Chung's past one-year tenure as party leader, calling it a "Lee-Chung showdown" and "self-serving politics," while raising the issue of responsibility for the defeat in the June 3 local elections. Chung and pro-Chung Supreme Council candidates actively rebutted these attacks. ( 이날 민주당은 순회경선 결과 발표에 앞서 충남, 충북, 대전·세종 권역별로 세 차례 후보 합동연설회를 열었다. 연설회에서는 ‘정청래 대 김민석·송영길’의 선거 구도가 뚜렷하게 드러났다. 김·송 후보와 이들을 따르는 최고위원 후보들은 정 후보의 지난 1년 대표 재임 시절을 “명-청(이재명-정청래) 대전”, “자기 정치”라 비판하며 6·3 지방선거 패배 책임론을 내세웠고, 정 후보와 친청계 최고위원 후보들은 이들의 공격을 적극적으로 반박했다.)

First, Kim targeted Chung, saying, "An extension of the 'Lee-Chung showdown' is hell for the Democratic Party, and we must close the gates of that hell," and "If you can't call anti-Lee what is anti-Lee, how can you be leadership?" Song also attacked Chung, saying, "The Lee Jae-myung government is being shaken because of (Chung's) self-serving politics," and "It's absurd to hear people claim they'll protect Lee Jae-myung while saying things that directly contradict the president's stance." ( 먼저 김 후보는 “‘명청 대전’의 연장전은 민주당의 지옥이고 그 지옥문을 닫아야 한다”, “반명(반이재명)을 반명이라 말하지 못하면 그것이 어찌 지도부겠느냐”고 정 후보를 겨냥했다. 송 후보도 “(정 후보의) 자기 정치 때문에 이재명 정부가 흔들리고 있다”, “대통령 인식에 정면으로 반대하는 얘기를 하면서 이재명을 지키겠다고 떠드는 우스꽝스러운 일이 벌어지고 있다”고 정 후보를 공격했다.)

In response, at the final Daejeon·Sejong joint rally, Chung fired back at Kim's attacks, saying, "'The blame for the local election defeat lies with Lee Jae-myung'—that was the interview Rep. Kim Min-seok gave during the local elections four years ago. Four years ago, he blamed Lee Jae-myung; four years later, he blames only Chung Cheong-rae. I will not engage in that kind of politics." He then took a direct shot at Kim's past, adding, "Wasn't the worst self-serving politics betraying Roh Moo-hyun in 2002 and flying over to Chung Mong-joon? One should have a sense of shame." ( 그러자 정 후보는 마지막 대전·세종 합동연설회에서 “‘지방선거 패배의 책임은 이재명에게 있다’, 이게 4년 전 지방선거 때 김민석 의원이 했던 인터뷰”라며 “4년 전에는 이재명 탓하고, 4년 후에는 정청래 탓만 하는 그런 정치를 저는 하지 않겠다”고 김 후보의 공격을 맞받았다. 이어 “최악의 자기 정치는 2002년 노무현을 배신하고 정몽주에게 날아간 것 아니겠느냐. 사람이 염치가 있어야 한다”고 김 후보의 과거 행적을 직격했다.)

Starting with the Chungcheong region that day, the Democratic Party will announce the results of the regional tour primaries for eligible party members in Busan·Ulsan·South Gyeongsang (Aug. 2), Jeju·Incheon (Aug. 8), Gangwon·Daegu·North Gyeongsang (Aug. 9), the Honam region (Aug. 15), and Seoul·Gyeonggi (Aug. 16). At the national convention on the 17th, the final results will be announced by combining 70% from delegate and eligible party member votes with 30% from a public opinion survey. ( 민주당은 이날 충청권을 시작으로 부산·울산·경남(오는 2일), 제주·인천(8일), 강원·대구·경북(9일), 호남권(15일), 서울·경기(16일) 권역별 순회경선 권리당원 투표 결과 발표를 거쳐, 17일 전당대회에서 대의원·권리당원 투표 70%와 국민여론조사 30%를 합산한 최종 전당대회 결과를 발표한다.)

Kim Chae-woon Reporter cwk@hani.co.kr ( 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Jae-myung must declare he will "not seek a second term" to ensure governance is possible. (이재명 대통령 “연임 안 한다” 선언해야 국정 운영 가능하다)
item.description:
“A constitutional amendment to extend the presidential term or change it to a two-term system shall have no effect with respect to the President in office at the time of the proposal of such constitutional amendment”—Article 128, Clause 2 of the Constitution is not a provision that makes amendment impossible. It is a rule restricting the retroactive application of constitutional amendments. It is an expression of sovereign will aimed at reflecting on dictators’ attempts to extend their rule through constitutional changes and promoting the democratization of power through a single-term presidency. (Seong Nak-in, Constitutional Law) (“대통령의 임기 연장 또는 중임 변경을 위한 헌법 개정은 그 헌법 개정 제안 당시의 대통령에 대하여는 효력이 없다”는 헌법 128조 2항은 개헌이 불가능한 한계 조항은 아닙니다. 헌법 개정의 효력에 관한 소급 적용 제한 규정입니다. 독재자들의 집권 연장 개헌을 반성하고 대통령 단임을 통한 권력의 민주화를 도모하려는 주권적 의사의 표현입니다. (성낙인, 헌법학))

Our country’s constitutional amendments have been tainted by dictators’ ambitions to prolong their hold on power. President Syngman Rhee, facing difficulty in reelection after losing the 1950 general election, instigated the Busan Political Crisis in 1952 to push through a partial constitutional amendment introducing direct presidential elections. During the 1954 “rounding-up” (sasa-oip) amendment, he inserted a provision in the supplementary rules stating that “the restriction under Article 55, Clause 1 (two-term presidency) shall not apply to the President at the time of the promulgation of this Constitution,” paving the way for a lifetime presidency. ( 우리나라 개헌은 독재자들의 집권 연장 야욕으로 얼룩져 있습니다. 이승만 대통령은 1950년 총선 패배로 대통령 연임이 어려워지자 1952년 부산정치파동을 일으켜 대통령직선제 발췌개헌을 했습니다. 1954년 사사오입 개헌 때는 부칙에 “이 헌법 공포 당시의 대통령에 대하여는 55조 1항(대통령 중임) 단서의 제한을 적용하지 아니한다”는 조항을 넣어 종신 대통령의 길을 열었습니다.)

Park Chung-hee, who seized power through a coup in 1961, dissolved the National Assembly and granted legislative functions to the Supreme Council for National Reconstruction. A new constitutional amendment was drafted by the Constitutional Deliberation Committee under that council and then put to a national referendum. The constitutional amendment procedures stipulated by the Constitution were completely ignored. Park Chung-hee again amended the Constitution in 1969 to enable his run for a third term. ( 1961년 쿠데타로 집권한 박정희는 국회를 해산하고 국가재건최고회의에 입법 기능을 부여했습니다. 새로운 헌법 개정안을 국가재건최고회의 산하 헌법심의위원회에서 만든 뒤 국민투표를 했습니다. 헌법이 정한 개헌 절차를 깡그리 무시했습니다. 박정희는 1969년에도 대통령 3선 출마를 위해 개헌했습니다.)

In 1972, he created the Yusin Constitution to rule for life. He dissolved the National Assembly and had an amendment drafted by the Emergency State Council, then confirmed it through a referendum. The constitutional amendment procedures prescribed by the Constitution were completely disregarded. ( 1972년에는 종신 집권을 위해 유신헌법을 만들었습니다. 국회를 해산하고 비상국무회의에서 만든 개헌안을 국민투표로 확정했습니다. 헌법이 정한 개헌 절차를 깡그리 무시했습니다.)

Chun Doo-hwan, who took power through a coup in 1980, became president through election by the National Conference for Unification. Under the Yusin Constitution, the president had the authority to propose constitutional amendments, and a presidential amendment could be finalized by referendum without going through the National Assembly. Following this procedure, Chun drew up the Fifth Republic Constitution and was then reelected president through an electoral college vote. A truly filthy history. ( 1980년 쿠데타로 집권한 전두환은 통일주체국민회의 선출로 대통령이 됐습니다. 유신헌법에는 대통령도 개헌안 발의 권한이 있었고, 대통령 발의 개헌안은 국회를 거치지 않고 국민투표로 확정하게 되어 있었습니다. 전두환은 이 절차에 따라 5공화국 헌법을 만든 뒤 선거인단 투표로 대통령에 다시 당선됐습니다. 정말 더러운 역사입니다.)

The June 1987 uprising led to a constitutional amendment restoring direct presidential elections. Originally, the Unified Democratic Party of Kim Young-sam and Kim Dae-jung demanded a four-year two-term system and a president-vice president structure. The Democratic Justice Party of Chun Doo-hwan and Roh Tae-woo fiercely opposed it, fearing a joint ticket of Kim Young-sam and Kim Dae-jung. A compromise was reached on a single five-year term. Article 128, Clause 2 was newly added to prevent any extension of the term or change to a two-term system. (1987년 6월 항쟁으로 대통령 직선제 개헌이 이뤄졌습니다. 본래 김영삼 김대중의 통일민주당은 4년 중임제와 정·부통령제를 요구했습니다. 전두환 노태우의 민정당은 격렬하게 반대했습니다. 김영삼 김대중의 정·부통령 동반 출마를 두려워한 것입니다. 5년 단임제로 절충이 이뤄졌습니다. 임기 연장이나 중임 변경을 막기 위해 128조 2항을 신설했습니다.)

Given this history, it is only natural that the public harbors fear about extending the presidential term or amending the Constitution to allow a second term. That is why National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik’s remarks at a press conference on July 28 caused such an uproar. Asked by a reporter whether President Lee Jae-myung could extend his term or change the system to allow reelection, Speaker Woo replied as follows. ( 이런 역사를 겪은 국민에게 대통령 임기 연장이나 연임 개헌에 대한 공포가 있는 것은 당연합니다. 7월28일 조정식 국회의장의 기자간담회 발언이 큰 파문을 일으킨 것은 그래서입니다. 이재명 대통령 임기 연장이나 연임 개헌이 가능하냐는 기자의 질문에 조정식 국회의장은 이렇게 답변했습니다.)

“That issue is premature to discuss now. Regarding the question of a sitting president’s reelection in relation to restructuring the power structure, I think it is a matter of public opinion and choice, as the people are the sovereign. It depends on how the political parties involved reach an agreement. It could become a point of contention later in discussions on power structure during constitutional amendment talks. Wouldn’t all views be gathered through an advisory committee on constitutional amendment or a special committee?” ( “그 문제는 뭐 지금 얘기하는 것이 시기상조다. 권력구조 개편과 관련해서 현직 대통령 연임 문제에 대한 생각은 주권자인 국민 여론과 선택의 문제라고 생각한다. 정치적 당사자들이 어떻게 합의하느냐에 달린 문제다. 나중에 개헌 논의에서 권력구조 문제 관계 논의에서 쟁점이 될 수 있다. 개헌자문위원회나 개헌특위를 통해서 다 수렴되지 않겠나.”)

This implies it could be possible depending on “public opinion and choice, as the people are the sovereign.” The political world was thrown into turmoil. Around 5 p.m., Senior Secretary for Public Relations and Communications Jang Hyun-joo stepped forward. ( ‘주권자인 국민 여론과 선택’에 따라서는 가능할 수 있다는 뜻입니다. 정가가 발칵 뒤집혔습니다. 오후 5시께 장현주 공보소통수석비서관이 나섰습니다.)

“Speaker Woo Won-shik is fully aware that a constitutional amendment to extend the presidential term or change it to a two-term system does not apply to the president in office at the time of the proposal. Reports suggesting he left open the possibility of a sitting president’s reelection are entirely at odds with the intent of his remarks.” ( “조정식 국회의장은 대통령 임기 연장 또는 중임 변경을 위한 헌법 개정은 제안 당시 대통령에게는 적용되지 않는다는 내용을 충분히 인식하고 있다. 현직 대통령의 연임 가능성을 열어뒀다는 보도는 발언 취지와 전혀 다르다.”)

The claim was that the media had misinterpreted the remarks. But the fallout did not subside. Past 11 p.m., Speaker Woo posted on Facebook. ( 언론이 발언 취지를 잘못 해석했다는 얘깁니다. 파장이 가라앉지 않았습니다. 밤 11시가 지나 조정식 국회의장이 페이스북에 글을 올렸습니다.)

“The content of Article 128, Clause 2 of the Constitution must be respected, and a sitting president’s reelection is not a subject of future constitutional amendment discussions. My answer at the press conference was intended to state the basic procedure—that for any constitutional amendment, including restructuring the power structure, to be achieved, consensus among political actors and the choice of the people are required. I regret that my remarks caused misunderstanding and controversy contrary to my intentions.” ( “헌법 제128조 제2항의 내용은 존중되어야 하며, 향후 이루어질 개헌 논의에 현직 대통령의 연임은 그 대상이 아니다. 기자간담회에서의 답변은 권력구조 개편을 포함해 개헌이 이루어지기 위해서는 정치 주체 간의 합의와 국민의 선택이 있어야만 가능하다는 취지의 기본 절차를 밝힌 것이다. 본의와 다르게 오해와 논란을 불러일으킨 점에 대해 유감스럽게 생각한다.”)

Really? Speaker Woo had prepared in advance for the press conference. He had extracted anticipated questions from reporters and prepared answers. The question of presidential reelection through constitutional amendment was reportedly fairly high on the list. Even so, he answered in a way suggesting it could be possible “depending on public opinion and choice, as the people are the sovereign.” ( 그런가요? 조정식 국회의장은 기자간담회를 앞두고 예습을 했습니다. 기자들의 예상 질문을 뽑아서 답변을 준비했습니다. 대통령 연임 개헌은 꽤 앞에 있었다고 합니다. 그런데도 ‘주권자인 국민 여론과 선택에 따라 가능하다’는 취지로 답변했습니다.)

Speaker Woo’s remarks are legally very flawed. What exactly is “public opinion and choice, as the people are the sovereign”? In the 1952 amendment, Syngman Rhee surrounded the National Assembly with the military and police to force through the partial amendment. In 1954, he committed the atrocity of altering the quorum through rounding. But since the National Assembly, the people’s representative body, had voted, was Rhee’s amendment therefore legitimate? By Speaker Woo’s logic, yes. ( 조정식 국회의장의 발언은 법리적으로 매우 잘못된 것입니다. ‘주권자인 국민 여론과 선택’이 과연 무엇일까요? 이승만 대통령은 1952년 개헌 때 군과 경찰로 국회를 포위한 가운데 발췌개헌안을 통과시켰습니다. 1954년 개헌 때는 사사오입으로 의결정족수를 바꾸는 만행을 저질렀습니다. 어쨌든 국민의 대표 기관인 국회가 의결했으니 이승만 대통령의 개헌은 정당한 것이었을까요? 조정식 국회의장의 논리대로라면 그렇습니다.)

Park Chung-hee’s 1962 Third Republic Constitution passed with 78.8% approval in a referendum. The 1969 third-term amendment passed with 65.1% approval. The 1972 Yusin Constitution passed with 91.5% approval. Chun Doo-hwan’s 1980 Fifth Republic Constitution passed with 91.6% approval. Since they passed referendums, were Park’s and Chun’s amendments therefore legitimate? By Speaker Woo’s logic, yes. ( 박정희의 1962년 3공화국 헌법은 국민투표에서 78.8%의 찬성으로 통과됐습니다. 1969년 3선 개헌은 65.1%가 찬성했습니다. 1972년 유신헌법은 91.5%가 찬성했습니다. 전두환의 1980년 5공 헌법은 91.6%가 찬성했습니다. 어쨌든 국민투표를 통과했으니 박정희와 전두환의 개헌은 정당한 것이었을까요? 조정식 국회의장의 논리대로라면 그렇습니다.)

Syngman Rhee, Park Chung-hee, and Chun Doo-hwan were dictators. They forced through constitutional amendments under coups and martial law. Those were not “choices of the sovereign” but “choices of dictators.” Speaker Woo’s mistake was failing to distinguish between “choices of the sovereign” and “choices of dictators.” If President Lee Jae-myung, like Rhee, Park, or Chun, were to stage a coup or suspend the constitutional order and put an amendment to a referendum, would that truly be a “choice of the sovereign”? ( 이승만 박정희 전두환은 독재자였습니다. 쿠데타와 계엄 상태에서 개헌을 밀어붙였습니다. ‘주권자의 선택’이 아니라 ‘독재자의 선택’이었습니다. 조정식 국회의장의 잘못은 ‘주권자의 선택’과 ‘독재자의 선택’을 구분하지 않은 것입니다. 만약 이재명 대통령이 이승만 박정희 전두환처럼 친위 쿠데타를 일으키거나 헌정을 중단시키고 개헌안을 국민투표에 부쳐 통과시킨다면 그게 과연 ‘주권자의 선택’일까요?)

It is also politically wrong. The idea of amending the Constitution to allow President Lee’s reelection was originally nothing more than a conspiracy theory of far-right forces. It was only natural for anyone with sound judgment to think it impossible. But then hardcore pro-Lee supporters began making immature remarks like “A president who does well should serve another term.” When Prime Minister Kim Min-seok said last December that “some say ‘five years is too short’ or ‘we wish he could serve longer,’” he was conveying exactly such public sentiment. Then former Minister Yoo Si-min and others raised baseless suspicions that “President Lee seems to be trying to abandon the Democratic Party’s traditional support base and push for a realignment of the political landscape to secure dismissal of indictments and a reelection amendment,” escalating the situation. (정치적으로도 잘못입니다. 이재명 대통령 연임 개헌은 본래 극우 세력의 음모론에 불과했습니다. 제정신을 가진 사람이라면 불가능하다고 생각하는 게 너무나 당연했기 때문입니다. 그런데 친이재명 강성 지지층에서 “일 잘하는 대통령은 연임해야 한다”는 철부지 발언이 나오기 시작했습니다. 지난해 12월 김민석 국무총리가 “‘5년이 너무 짧다’ ‘더 했으면 좋겠다’ 하는 분들도 있다”고 한 게 바로 그런 여론을 전한 것입니다. 여기에 유시민 전 장관 등이 ‘이재명 대통령이 공소 취소와 연임 개헌을 위해 민주당의 전통적인 지지층을 버리고 정계개편을 추진하려는 것 같다’고 근거 없는 의혹을 제기하면서 사태가 심각해졌습니다.)

Speaker Woo’s remarks lend weight to those far-right conspiracy theories, the immature sentiments of hardcore pro-Lee supporters, and the irresponsible suspicions raised by former Minister Yoo Si-min. This inevitably deals a blow to President Lee, who is already struggling with rising real estate prices and a falling stock market. ( 조정식 국회의장의 발언은 이러한 극우 세력 음모론, 친이재명 강성 지지층의 철부지 여론, 유시민 전 장관 등의 무책임한 의혹 제기에 힘을 실어주는 것입니다. 그렇지 않아도 부동산 가격 상승, 주가 하락으로 고전하는 이재명 대통령에게 타격이 불가피합니다.)

According to a national indicator survey released on July 30, party approval ratings were 40% for the Democratic Party and 21% for the People Power Party, widening slightly from two weeks earlier. This appears to be the effect of the Democratic Party’s national convention. However, presidential job approval stood at 53% positive and 37% negative, the worst since taking office. If public sentiment deteriorates further, there is a risk of losing the momentum for governance. (Refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website.) ( 7월30일 발표한 전국지표조사에서 정당 지지도는 민주당 40%, 국민의힘 21%로 2주 전보다 조금 더 벌어졌습니다. 민주당 전당대회 효과로 보입니다. 그러나 대통령 국정 평가는 긍정 53%, 부정 37%로 취임 이후 가장 나빴습니다. 여론이 더 악화하면 국정 운영의 동력을 상실할 위험이 있습니다. (중앙선거여론조사심의위 누리집 참고))

Why on earth did Speaker Woo make such remarks? Some analyze it as a mistake. Others see it as intentional. Speaker Woo is a six-term lawmaker with outstanding political acumen. Having served as policy committee chair and secretary-general, he is also well-versed in practical affairs. People like him do not make mistakes. I find the intentional analysis more persuasive. (조정식 국회의장은 도대체 왜 그런 발언을 했을까요? 실수라는 분석이 있습니다. 의도적으로 했다는 분석이 있습니다. 조정식 국회의장은 6선 국회의원입니다. 정무 감각이 탁월합니다. 정책위의장, 사무총장을 지내 실무에도 밝습니다. 이런 사람은 실수하지 않습니다. 저는 의도적이라는 분석이 좀 더 설득력이 있다고 봅니다.)

Speaker Woo is closer to President Lee than anyone. He served as secretary-general when Lee was party leader and also worked as a senior presidential secretary for political affairs. During the race for the National Assembly Speaker candidacy, he received overt support from President Lee. He is in a position where he owes a debt of gratitude. ( 조정식 국회의장은 이재명 대통령과 누구보다도 가깝습니다. 이재명 대표 시절 사무총장을 했고 대통령 정무특보도 했습니다. 국회의장 후보자 경선 때는 이재명 대통령의 노골적인 지원을 받았습니다. 보은해야 할 처지입니다.)

It seems he deliberately held a press conference during the president’s overseas trip to test the waters on public sentiment regarding a reelection amendment. When the backlash proved stronger than expected, he appears to have hastily abandoned the reelection amendment card. ( 연임 개헌에 대한 여론을 살피기 위해 대통령 해외 순방 기간에 일부러 기자간담회를 열어 간을 본 것 같습니다. 예상보다 역풍이 강하게 불자 부랴부랴 연임 개헌 카드를 접은 것 같습니다.)

The problem is that the matter will not be resolved just by doing that. Representative Jang Dong-hyuk and the People Power Party are launching an all-out offensive against the administration. This will likely continue for some time. The constitutional amendment Speaker Woo proposed has also become completely impossible. How should this be managed? ( 문제는 그런다고 사태가 해결되지 않는다는 것입니다. 장동혁 대표와 국민의힘은 대여 총공세에 나서고 있습니다. 당분간 계속 그럴 것입니다. 조정식 국회의장이 제안한 개헌도 아예 불가능하게 됐습니다. 어떻게 수습해야 할까요?)

Some argue Speaker Woo should take responsibility and resign. Others argue President Lee should declare upon his return on the 3rd that he will not pursue a reelection amendment. Both have merit. The fallout from this incident seems unlikely to subside without that level of high-impact measures. ( 조정식 국회의장이 책임지고 사퇴해야 한다는 주장이 있습니다. 이재명 대통령이 오는 3일 귀국 직후 연임 개헌을 하지 않겠다고 선언해야 한다는 주장이 있습니다. 둘 다 일리가 있습니다. 이번 사태의 파장은 그 정도 고단위 처방이 아니면 가라앉지 않을 것 같습니다.)

The most reasonable proposal for a presidential term amendment is to switch to a four-year two-term system and, starting in 2030, hold the presidential election and nationwide local elections simultaneously. Although it would be a four-year two-term system, the dynamism of our politics makes it highly likely to effectively become a four-year single-term system. ( 가장 합리적인 대통령 임기 개헌안은 4년 중임제로 바꾸고 2030년부터 대통령 선거와 전국동시 지방선거를 같이 치르는 것입니다. 4년 중임이라고 하지만 우리나라 정치의 역동성 때문에 사실상 4년 단임제가 될 가능성이 큽니다.)

In any case, to amend the Constitution, President Lee must take the lead. He must persuade the public and the opposition. To do so, he must clearly state that he will “not seek a second term.” Only then will a path open—whether for a staged amendment or a power-structure amendment. Only then can he steer state affairs normally. Can President Lee do it? What do you think? ( 어쨌든 개헌하려면 이재명 대통령이 나서야 합니다. 국민과 야당을 설득해야 합니다. 그러기 위해서는 “연임하지 않겠다”는 의사를 확실히 밝혀야 합니다. 그래야 순차 개헌이든, 권력구조 개헌이든 길이 열립니다. 그래야 국정도 정상적으로 이끌어갈 수 있을 것 같습니다. 이재명 대통령이 할 수 있을까요? 여러분은 어떻게 생각하십니까?)

Senior Political Correspondent shy99@hani.co.kr ( 정치부 선임기자 shy99@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Yong-min lays "prosecution investigation power abolition" envelope at former President Roh's grave: "Finished the assignment you gave us" (김용민, 노 전 대통령 묘역에 ‘검사 수사권 폐지’ 봉투…“내주신 숙제 끝냈다”)
item.description:
As the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act abolishing prosecutors' direct investigative authority passed under the ruling party's leadership, Kim Yong-min, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea, presented the amendment at the grave of the late former President Roh Moo-hyun, saying, "I've completed all the assignments you gave us." (검사의 직접 수사 권한을 폐지하는 형사소송법 개정안이 여당 주도로 통과한 가운데 김용민 더불어민주당 의원은 개정안을 고 노무현 전 대통령 묘역에 바치며 “내주신 숙제 다 끝냈다”고 했다.)

On the 1st, Kim visited Bongha Village in Jinyeong-eup, Gimhae, South Gyeongsang Province, paid his respects at Roh's grave, and posted photos on X (formerly Twitter). Kim placed an envelope containing the Criminal Procedure Act amendment at the grave and laid a floral tribute reading, "We've finished all the assignments you gave us, Mr. President." Wearing a yellow tie, Kim also sat beside Roh's statue with a smile. His office added to the post, "Is the late President Roh saying, 'Hey, this feels great~'?" (김 의원은 1일 경남 김해 진영읍 봉하마을을 찾아 노 전 대통령 묘역을 참배한 뒤 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 사진을 올렸다. 김 의원은 묘역에 형사소송법 개정안이 담긴 서류봉투를 올려놓았고 ‘내주신 숙제 다 끝냈습니다, 대통령님’이라고 적힌 조화를 함께 두었다. 김 의원은 노란색 넥타이를 차고 노 전 대통령 동상 옆에 앉아 미소를 짓기도 했다. 김 의원 의원실은 해당 게시물에 “노 전 대통령님 ‘야~ 기분 좋다~’라고 하고 계신가요?”라고 적었다.)

Kim, a former lawyer who took the lead in passing the amendment on the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, wrote on Facebook on the 31st after the bill passed the plenary session, "Today I kept my promise to complete prosecutorial reform after giving up my bid for party leader. I rolled here even with bare hands and finally arrived. Thank you to everyone who endured the fierce resistance with me." His office said he then headed straight to Bongha Village. (변호사 출신으로 국회 법제사법위원회에서 이번 개정안 통과에 앞장선 김 의원은 지난달 31일 개정안이 국회 본회의를 통과하자 페이스북에 “당대표 출마를 포기하며 검찰 개혁을 완수하겠다는 약속을 오늘 지켰다”며 “맨몸으로라도 굴러서 마침내 도착했다. 강력한 저항을 함께 버텨내주신 모든 분들 감사하다”고 올렸다. 이후 바로 봉하마을로 달려왔다고 김 의원 쪽은 밝힌 바 있다.)

On the 1st, Kim also said on Facebook, "While the last bastion of democracy is the organized power of awakened citizens, the last bastion protecting the vested-interest cartel was the prosecution. That's why conservative media are now gripped by fear." (김 의원은 1일에도 페이스북에서 “민주주의 최후의 보루가 깨어있는 시민의 조직된 힘인 반면 기득권 카르텔을 지키는 최후의 보루는 검찰이었다. 그래서 보수 언론이 지금 공포에 질린 것이다”라고 말했다.)

The amendment will take effect on October 2, when the prosecution service is abolished and the Serious Crime Investigation Office and the Public Prosecution Office are launched. Once the law takes effect, prosecutors will be unable to conduct direct investigations or even supplementary investigations. Prosecutors will only retain the authority to request supplementary investigations from judicial police officers. (이번 개정안은 오는 10월2일 검찰청이 폐지되고 중대범죄수사청(중수청)·공소청이 출범하며 시행된다. 법이 시행되면 검찰은 직접수사는 물론 보완수사도 할 수 없게 된다. 검사는 사법경찰관에게 보완수사를 요구할 수 있는 권한만 갖는다.)

After the bill passed, the Democratic Party praised itself, saying, "We placed prosecutorial power under the control of the Constitution and the people," but the opposition is strongly resisting. The People Power Party plans to hold a Supreme Council meeting in front of the presidential office on the 3rd and urge President Lee Jae-myung to exercise his right to request reconsideration of the amendment. (법안 통과 뒤 민주당은 “검찰 권력을 헌법과 국민 통제 아래로 돌렸다”고 자평했지만, 야당은 거세게 반발 중이다. 국민의힘은 3일 청와대 앞에서 최고위원회 회의를 열고 이재명 대통령에게 개정안에 대한 재의요구권 행사를 촉구하겠다는 계획이다.)

item.title: South Korea's Daejeon warship becomes 'Top Gun of the Sea'... Accurately hits targets 7.2 km away (한국 대전함, ‘바다의 탑건’ 됐다…7.2㎞ 밖 표적 잘 쏴)
item.description:
The Navy's 3,100-ton frigate Daejeon (FFG) has been named the top combat ship, or 'Top Gun of the Sea,' in the gunnery competition of the '2026 Rim of the Pacific Exercise' (RIMPAC), the world's largest multinational maritime exercise. This marks the first time a South Korean naval vessel has earned 'Top Gun of the Sea' at RIMPAC since the Sejong the Great destroyer in 2010, a gap of 16 years. (해군의 3100t급 호위함인 대전함(FFG)이 세계 최대 다국적 해상훈련 ‘2026 환태평양훈련'(RIMPAC·림팩) 포술 경연에서 최우수 전투함인 ‘바다의 탑건’으로 선정됐다. 한국 해군 함정이 림팩에서 ‘바다의 탑건’이 된 것은 2010년 세종대왕함 이후 16년 만이다.)

According to the Navy on the 2nd, the Daejeon achieved the highest score in the RIMPAC Naval Surface Fire Support competition held on the 12th of last month (local time) in Hawaii, U.S., with 13 ships from 10 countries participating, and was selected as the top combat ship in gunnery. The Naval Surface Fire Support competition was conducted in a format where each ship fired five rounds from its 5-inch naval gun at a target 7.2 km away, and the ship with the smallest combined deviation distance from the target won. The results were kept confidential until the conclusion of the exercise and were announced at the RIMPAC closing ceremony held on the 31st of last month. (2일 해군에 따르면 대전함은 10개국 함정 13척이 참가한 가운데 미국 하와이에서 지난달 12일(현지시각) 개최된 림팩 해상화력지원 경연에서 가장 높은 점수를 얻어 포술 최우수 전투함으로 선발됐다. 해상화력지원 경연은 7.2㎞ 떨어진 표적에 각 함정이 5인치 함포를 5발씩 발사해 표적으로부터 오차 거리의 합이 가장 작은 함정이 우승하는 방식으로 진행됐다. 경연 결과는 훈련 폐막 때까지 비공개로 유지되다가 지난달 31일 열린 림팩 폐막식에서 발표됐다.)

The Navy stated that ahead of the competition, which was held in the open-ocean environment of the Pacific, different from domestic coastal waters, and required a high level of mission proficiency and teamwork, the Daejeon's entire crew repeated tactical discussions and simulated firing drills involving all crew members to master the firing procedures. Commander Lee Jung-soo (Lieutenant Colonel), captain of the Daejeon, said, "Winning the top combat ship award is the result of all Daejeon crew members dedicating themselves to training with one heart, and it is a meaningful achievement that recognized the excellence of South Korea's K-defense industry and the Navy's outstanding operational capabilities on the international stage." He added, "We will continue to strengthen our combat capabilities through realistic education and training to ensure we can fully accomplish assigned missions." (대전함은 국내 연안과 다른 태평양의 원해 환경에서 진행돼 높은 임무 숙련도와 팀워크가 요구되는 이번 경연을 앞두고 전 승조원이 참여하는 전술토의와 모의 사격훈련을 반복하며 사격 절차를 숙달했다고 해군은 밝혔다. 이정수 대전함장(중령)은 “이번 최우수 전투함 수상은 대전함 승조원 모두가 한마음으로 훈련에 매진한 결과이며, 대한민국 케이(K)-방산의 우수성과 해군의 뛰어난 작전 수행 능력을 국제무대에서 인정받은 뜻깊은 성과”라며 “실전적인 교육훈련을 통해 부여된 임무를 반드시 완수할 수 있는 전투역량을 지속적으로 강화해 나가겠다”고 말했다.)

RIMPAC is a biennial exercise hosted by the U.S. 3rd Fleet to enhance multinational maritime operational capabilities, including protecting sea lanes in the Pacific and improving joint response capabilities to maritime threats. This year's RIMPAC marked the first time the South Korean Navy conducted the mission of Combined Forces Maritime Component Commander, exercising overall command of maritime forces. (림팩은 태평양 연안 해상교통로 보호, 해양 위협에 대한 공동 대처 능력 증진 등 다국적 해양 작전 능력 향상을 위해 미 3함대사령부 주관으로 격년마다 열리는 훈련이다. 올해 림팩에서는 처음으로 한국 해군이 해상전력을 총지휘하는 연합해군구성군사령관 임무를 수행하기도 했다.)

item.title: Events Including Academic Conference and Exhibition in August for 'UNESCO Commemoration of Kim Gu's 150th Birthday' (‘김구 탄생 150주년 유네스코 기념해’ 맞아 8월 학술대회·전시 등 열려)
item.description:
The Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs announced on the 2nd that it will intensively promote commemorative projects such as academic events, exhibitions, and performances throughout August to mark the 'UNESCO Commemoration of Kim Gu's 150th Birthday'. (국가보훈부는 ‘김구 탄생 150주년 유네스코 기념해’를 맞아 8월 한 달간 학술행사·전시·공연 등 기념사업을 집중적으로 추진한다고 2일 밝혔다.)

As UNESCO designated this year, which marks the 150th birthday of Baekbeom Kim Gu, as a 'UNESCO commemoration year,' various programs have been prepared to allow the public to engage with Kim Gu's life and ideas and reflect on their significance. UNESCO selects anniversaries of prominent figures and historical events proposed by member states to highlight them internationally. At the 43rd UNESCO General Conference held last October, it was assessed that Kim Gu's vision of pursuing world peace through the 'power of culture' rather than military or economic strength aligns with UNESCO's universal values, leading to this year, the 150th anniversary of his birth, being designated as a UNESCO commemoration year. (유네스코가 백범 김구 탄생 150주년이 되는 올해를 ‘유네스코 기념해’로 지정함에 따라 국민이 김구의 삶과 사상을 접하고 그 의미를 되새길 수 있도록 다양한 프로그램을 마련했다. 유네스코는 회원국이 제안한 저명한 인물과 역사적 사건의 기념주년을 선정해 국제적으로 조명하는데, 지난해 10월 유네스코 43차 총회에서 군사력이나 경제력이 아닌 ‘문화의 힘’을 통해 세계 평화를 추구한 김구 선생의 비전이 유네스코의 보편적 가치와 부합한다고 평가해 탄생 150주년인 올해를 유네스코 기념해로 선정했다.)

The Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs will first designate the period from the 25th to the 30th of this month as a 'Culture Week' under the theme 'My Wish, Culture of Peace,' featuring public-participatory music performances and an international academic conference highlighting Kim Gu's leadership. A media wall themed around Kim Gu's 'My Wish' will be installed at Gwanghwamun from the 26th to the 30th. A ceremony commemorating the 150th birthday of Kim Gu will be held on the 29th of this month. (국가보훈부는 우선 이달 25일부터 30일까지를 ‘나의 소원, 평화의 문화’를 주제로 한 ‘문화주간’으로 정하고 국민 참여형 음악공연, 김구 리더십을 조명하는 국제학술대회 등을 개최한다. 광화문에는 김구의 ‘나의 소원’을 주제로 한 미디어월을 26∼30일 설치한다. 이달 29일에는 김구 탄생 150주년 기념식이 열린다.)

Ahead of Culture Week, plans include introducing a mobile game content that allows users to experience Kim Gu's journey of the independence movement and conducting promotional campaigns in four cities across the country to raise public interest. (문화주간을 앞두고는 김구의 독립운동 여정을 체험하는 모바일 게임 콘텐츠를 선보이고 전국 4개 도시에서 홍보캠페인을 벌여 국민들의 관심을 높일 계획이다.)

Details on the schedule and locations of the commemorative projects can be found on the website for the 'UNESCO Commemoration of Kim Gu's 150th Birthday' (https://kimkoo150.kr). (기념사업 일정과 장소 등은 ‘김구 탄생 150주년 유네스코 기념해’ 안내 누리집(https://kimkoo150.kr)에서 확인할 수 있다.)

item.title: Han Sung-sook issues urgent directive on 'extreme heat' response... "Strengthen protection for vulnerable groups and on-site inspections" (한성숙, ‘극한 폭염’ 대응 긴급 지시…“취약계층 보호·현장점검 강화”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Han Sung-sook on the 2nd issued an urgent directive for a full-scale response to relevant ministries and local governments, as concerns grew over damage from extreme heat, including the activation of Level 2 of the Central Disaster and Safety Countermeasures Headquarters (CDSCH). (한성숙 국무총리가 2일 극한 폭염으로 중앙재난안전대책본부(중대본) 2단계가 발령되는 등 피해가 우려되자, 관계부처와 지방 정부에 총력 대응을 긴급 지시했다.)

On the same day, the Prime Minister ordered the Ministry of the Interior and Safety to review the implementation status of heatwave countermeasures by relevant ministries and local governments, and to actively coordinate and support a pan-ministerial heatwave response. She also asked local governments to thoroughly inspect whether heat shelters and heat-reduction facilities are operating without issues, and to take immediate action on any matters requiring improvement. (한 총리는 이날 행정안전부에 관계부처 및 지방 정부의 폭염 대책 추진 상황을 점검하고, 범부처 폭염대응이 유기적으로 이뤄지도록 적극 조정·지원할 것을 주문했다. 아울러, 지방정부에 무더위 쉼터 및 폭염 저감시설 운영에 문제가 없는지 철저히 점검하고 보완이 필요한 사항은 즉시 조처해달라고 했다.)

The Prime Minister also instructed the Ministry of Health and Welfare to check the cooling operations of senior citizen centers and shelters frequently used by heat-vulnerable groups such as elderly living alone and residents of single-room occupancies, and to ensure thorough protection measures including regular check-in calls and visits. She also asked the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs to actively conduct village broadcasts urging elderly farmers to refrain from overexerting themselves in rice paddies and fields, and to carry out related on-site inspections in cooperation with local governments. (한 총리는 또 보건복지부에 홀몸노인, 쪽방 거주민 등 폭염 취약계층이 주로 이용하는 경로당, 쉼터 등의 냉방 가동상황을 점검하고 수시로 안부 전화 및 방문을 실시하는 보호 대책에 만전을 기해달라 주문했다. 농림축산식품부에는 고령인 농업인의 무리한 논·밭일을 자제하도록 하는 마을방송을 적극 실시하게 하고, 지방정부와 협력해 관련 현장점검을 실시해달라고 당부했다.)

The Prime Minister ordered the Ministry of Employment and Labor to inspect compliance with the five basic heatwave safety rules and the implementation of worker protection measures at logistics centers, construction sites, and other locations, and to provide guidance and oversight so that work stoppages or adjustments to work hours are actively carried out during peak heat hours. (한 총리는 고용노동부에는 물류센터, 건설현장 등에서의 폭염 안전 5대 기본수칙 준수 여부와 노동자 보호조처 이행실태를 점검하고 무더위 시간에는 작업중지 및 작업시간 변경이 적극적으로 이뤄지도록 지도·점검해달라고 주문했다.)

The Prime Minister directed the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries to promptly provide necessary on-site support, such as cooling devices and high-water-temperature response equipment. Additionally, she asked the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment to frequently monitor power reserve margins, and to closely manage the water storage status of dams and reservoirs as well as the supply of domestic and industrial water in drought-vulnerable areas. (한 총리는 농림축산식품부와 해양수산부는 냉방장치, 고수온 대응장비 등 현장에서 필요한 지원을 신속하게 조처하도록 했다. 또 기후에너지환경부에는 전력 예비율 등을 수시 점검하고 댐과 저수지의 용수 저장 현황, 가뭄 취약 지역의 생활·공업용수 공급 상황을 면밀히 관리해달라고 했다.)

item.title: Kwon Young-jin of 'Collar Grab Disturbance' Says "I Won't Voluntarily Leave the Party; I'll Accept a Fair Punishment" (‘멱살 소동’ 권영진 “자진 탈당 안해, 징계 합당하면 수용”)
item.description:
Kwon Young-jin, a lawmaker referred to the party's ethics committee after grabbing the collar of People Power Party floor leader Chung Jin-suk over dissatisfaction with the allocation of standing committee posts, has stated he will not voluntarily leave the party. (국회 상임위원회 배분에 불만을 갖고 정점식 국민의힘 원내대표의 멱살을 잡아 당 윤리위원회에 회부된 권영진 의원이 자진 탈당은 하지 않겠다고 밝혔다.)

According to political circles on the 2nd, Kwon sent a text message the previous day to party members in his constituency of Dae-gu Dalseo-gu B, saying, "I will never voluntarily leave the party." He also said, "I have already stepped down from my positions as chairman of the Dae-gu city party chapter and secretary of the Public Administration and Security Committee to take responsibility," adding, "If the ethics committee decides on a fair and appropriate punishment, I intend to accept it." (2일 정치권에 따르면 권 의원은 전날 지역구인 대구 달서병 당원들에게 “스스로 탈당하는 일은 결코 없을 것”이라는 내용의 문자를 보냈다. 그는 “이미 저는 책임을 지고자 대구시당위원장과 행정안전위원 간사직을 내려놓았다”며 “윤리위원회에서 공정하고 합당한 징계가 결정된다면 수용할 생각”이라고도 했다.)

With Kwon drawing a line against voluntary departure, the ethics committee is expected to accelerate disciplinary action against him and others. Earlier, on the 27th of last month, the party's supreme council stated that if Kwon did not voluntarily leave the party, the ethics committee should impose the highest level of punishment. On the same day, the ethics committee voted to begin disciplinary proceedings against Kwon and lawmakers Cho Kyung-tae and Jin Jong-oh. Criticism arose that the decision lacked procedural legitimacy because only three of the committee's five members participated, prompting the supreme council to appoint two additional ethics committee members on the 30th of last month. At the time, there was resistance within the supreme council over the need for further discussion, but it was reported that pro-leadership figures pushed through a vote, insisting the matter be handled swiftly. (권 의원이 자진 탈당에 선을 그으면서 윤리위는 권 의원 등에 대한 징계에 속도를 낼 것으로 보인다. 앞서 국민의힘 최고위원회의는 지난달 27일 권 의원이 자진 탈당 하지 않으면 윤리위에서 최고 수준의 징계를 해야 한다는 입장을 밝힌 바 있다. 윤리위는 같은날 권 의원과 조경태·진종오 의원에 대한 징계 개시를 의결했다. 이 의결에 윤리위 정원 5명 중 3명만 참여한 것을 두고 절차적 정당성이 부족하다는 비판이 나왔고, 최고위는 지난달 30일 윤리위원 2명을 추가로 선임했다. 당시 최고위에서는 “추가 논의가 필요하다”는 반발도 있었지만, 당권파 인사들이 “빠르게 진행해야 한다”며 표결을 강행한 것으로 전해졌다.)

Cho Hee-yeon, Reporter choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Min-seok and Jeong Cheong-rae Each Threaten "Referral to Party Ethics Committee"… Targeting Factional Acts and Shincheonji Allegations (김민석·정청래 서로 “당 윤리위 제소”…계파행위·신천지 의혹 겨냥)
item.description:
At the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention's nationwide tour primary, candidates Kim Min-seok and Jeong Cheong-rae, both running in the party leadership race, clashed as each vowed to "refer the other to the party ethics committee." Kim targeted what he called organized encouragement of "birthday voting" by Jeong's camp, while Jeong took issue with Kim's raising of allegations about Shincheonji's involvement in the convention. (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 전국순회경선에서 당대표 선거에 출마한 김민석 후보와 정청래 후보가 양쪽을 향해 “당 윤리위원회에 제소하겠다”며 공방을 벌였다. 김 후보는 정 후보 쪽의 조직적 ‘생일투표’ 독려 등을 겨냥했으며, 정 후보는 김 후보의 전당대회 신천지 개입 의혹 제기를 문제 삼았다.)

At a joint campaign speech held on the 2nd at the Ulsan Exhibition Convention Center in Ulju-gun, Ulsan, Kim said, "I will refer to the ethics committee all those who engaged in wrongful factional acts during the election process or who made wrongful attacks and incitements against rival candidates' speeches," adding, "Even if they manage to enter the leadership, they will face judgment." He continued, "When I pointed out the old-fashioned factional politics that have never once occurred in the Democratic Party's history, they lied, claiming it was lawful and that even Roh Moo-hyun and Moon Jae-in did the same," and criticized, "Such brazen leadership must not turn the party into a schoolyard." <<> Jeong took a sharp stance on Kim's Shincheonji involvement allegations. item.title: Joo Jin-woo Claims "Presidential Election Turnout Was Also Manipulated" — Says Numbers Suddenly Stopped and Then Rose (주진우 “대선 투표율도 조작”…갑자기 멈추고 늘었다 주장)
item.description:
Amid revelations that the National Election Commission (NEC) entered fraudulent time-based turnout figures for the June 3 local elections, the People Power Party has raised suspicions that turnout at 109 polling stations in the 21st presidential election was also falsified. Cases where the number of voters increased in uniform increments of 100 or did not increase at all for certain periods are suspected to be false entries, given their unrealistic nature. (중앙선거관리위원회(선관위)가 6·3 지방선거 시간대별 투표율을 허위로 입력한 정황이 드러난 가운데, 국민의힘이 21대 대선도 109개 투표구 투표율이 허위로 조작됐다는 의혹을 제기했다. 투표자 수가 100명 단위로 일정하게 늘어나거나 일정 시간 동안 한 명도 늘어나지 않는 등 비현실적으로 기재된 사례로 볼 때 허위 입력이 의심된다는 것이다.)

People Power Party lawmaker Joo Jin-woo held a press conference at the National Assembly on the 2nd, citing three representative examples and claiming that "in the 21st presidential election, the NEC deliberately manipulated the turnout." (주진우 국민의힘 의원은 2일 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 대표적인 세 가지 사례를 들어 “21대 대선에서 선관위는 투표율을 고의로 조작했다”고 주장했다.)

Joo first explained that five polling stations nationwide entered voter counts in increments of 100 by time period. Among them, three polling places in Hongeun 2-dong, Seodaemun-gu, Seoul, showed records of 100 voters at 7 a.m., 100 at 8 a.m., 100 at 9 a.m., 200 at 10 a.m., 100 at 11 a.m., 200 at noon, and 200 at 1 p.m. There was also a case like Uichang-gu, Changwon, where the count increased by exactly 100 every hour for five consecutive hours from 7 a.m. to noon. "Did they deliberately cap the vote counts?" Joo said. "It is clear they entered false data into the server." (주 의원은 먼저 전국 5개 투표구가 시간대별 투표자 수를 100명 단위로 입력했다고 설명했다. 그 가운데 서울 서대문구 홍은2동 투표소 3곳은 오전 7시 100명, 8시 100명, 9시 100명, 10시 200명, 11시 100명, 12시 200명, 오후 1시 200명이 투표했다는 기록이 제시됐다. 창원 의창구처럼 오전 7시부터 낮 12시까지 5시간 연속 100명씩 증가한 사례도 있었다. 주 의원은 “투표수를 일부러 제한했나”라며 “서버에 허위 입력한 것이 분명하다”고 했다.)

There were also 90 polling stations where the number of voters did not increase at all for a certain period. At Namchon 1 polling station in Osan, Gyeonggi Province, the voter count rose by 259 in one hour, then did not increase at all for the next three hours. (일정 시간 동안 투표자 수가 단 한명도 증가하지 않은 투표구도 90곳 있었다. 경기 오산시 남촌1투표구에서는 1시간 동안 투표자가 259명이 증가한 뒤, 3시간 동안엔 한명도 늘어나지 않았던 것이다.)

Fourteen polling stations were found where only one or two voters were added for two or more consecutive hours. A representative case is Segok-dong 1 polling station in Gangnam-gu, Seoul, where 292 voters were recorded in one hour, followed by only 2 voters over the next two hours. "Voting cannot suddenly stop based on turnout trends," Joo said, calling it "turnout manipulation." He added, "This is not the National Election Commission but the National Election Manipulation Committee" and "Deliberately entering false voter counts into the server in the local elections and then the last presidential election is an organized, habitual criminal act." (2시간 이상 연속으로 1명 혹은 2명만 증가한 투표구는 14곳 발견됐다. 서울 강남구 세곡동1투표구처럼 한 시간 동안 292명이 증가한 후, 2시간 동안 2명만 투표했다는 기록이 대표적이다. 주 의원은 “투표율 추이 상 갑자기 투표가 멈출 수 없다”며 ‘투표율 조작’이라고 했다. 이어 “선거관리위원회가 아니라 선거조작위원회”라며 “지방선거에 이어 지난 대선까지 투표자 수를 서버에 고의로 허위 입력한 것은 조직적·습관적 범죄 행위”라고 덧붙였다.)

Speaking to reporters, Joo said, "Rather than re-counting ballots at Olympic Park, I counter-propose to the Democratic Party that the NEC's computer servers be re-verified first through bipartisan agreement in the special committee for parliamentary investigation" and "We will discuss it in the special committee." (주 의원은 기자들과 만나 “국정조사특위에서 올림픽공원을 재검표할 것이 아니라 선관위 전산 서버부터 여야 합의로 재검증할 것을 민주당에 역제안한다”며 “국조특위에서 논의해보겠다”고 했다.)

Reporter Cho Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Foreign Ministry inspects sites of Korea's independence movement in China ahead of Liberation Day (외교부, 광복절 앞두고 중국 내 독립운동 사적지 점검)
item.description:
The Foreign Ministry said on the 2nd that it has inspected the status of Korea's independence movement historical sites in China ahead of the Liberation Day. (외교부는 광복절을 앞두고 중국 내 독립운동 사적지 현황을 점검했다고 2일 밝혔다.)

On the 31st of last month, the Foreign Ministry held a 'Meeting of Officials in Charge of History and Historical Sites in the China Region' in Chongqing, China, chaired by Na Yong-uk, a senior review officer at the Northeast and Central Asia Bureau. The meeting was attended by officials in charge of history and historical sites from diplomatic missions in China and related agencies, including the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs, the Independence Hall of Korea, and the Northeast Asian History Foundation. ( 외교부는 지난달 31일 중국 충칭에서 나용욱 동북·중앙아시아국 심의관 주재로 ‘중국 지역 역사·사적지 담당관 회의'를 개최했다. 회의에는 중국 지역 공관과 국가보훈부, 독립기념관, 동북아역사재단 등 유관기관의 역사·사적지 업무 담당자들이 참석했다.)

Based on the on-site inspection results from overseas missions, participants comprehensively reviewed the preservation and management status of Korea's independence movement historical sites in China. They also discussed ways to institutionalize the preservation and management of historical sites between Korea and China, and measures to revitalize exchanges between the people of both countries by expanding the use of the provisional government buildings in Shanghai and Chongqing. Approximately 47 percent of the overseas independence movement sites registered with the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs are located in China. ( 참석자들은 회의에서 재외공관의 현장점검 결과를 토대로 중국 내 우리 독립운동 사적지의 보존·관리 현황을 종합적으로 점검했다. 또한 한중 간 사적지 보존·관리의 제도화 방안, 상하이와 충칭의 임시정부 청사 활용을 확대해 양국 국민 간 교류를 활성화하는 방안 등을 논의했다. 국가보훈부 등록 해외 독립사적지의 약 47%가 중국 내에 있다.)

After the meeting, Senior Review Officer Na and the officials visited major independence movement historical sites in Chongqing, including the Memorial Hall of the General Headquarters of the Korean Restoration Army, the temporary government building in Yeonhwa-ji, the site of Osa-ya Port and the former residence site of Yi Dong-nyeong, to inspect their current condition. They also visited the Qijiang Museum, which displays historical materials about figures of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea and their families who lived in the Qijiang area after the provisional government moved to Chongqing in 1940. ( 회의를 마친 나 심의관과 담당관들은 한국광복군총사령부기념관, 대한민국 임시정부 연화지 청사, 오사야항 터, 이동녕 선생 거주지 터 등 충칭에 있는 주요 독립운동 사적지를 찾아 현황을 점검하고 치장박물관도 방문했다. 치장박물관은 1940년 대한민국 임시정부가 충칭으로 이전한 뒤, 치장 지역에 거주했던 대한민국 임시정부 요인과 그 가족들에 관한 사료를 전시 중이다.)

The Foreign Ministry said it will continue to cooperate closely with related agencies to strengthen the preservation and management of Korea's independence movement historical sites in China, and will continue diplomatic efforts to secure cooperation from the Chinese side. ( 외교부는 앞으로도 중국에 있는 우리 독립운동 사적지의 보존·관리 강화를 위해 유관기관과 긴밀히 협력하고, 중국 측의 협조를 확보하기 위한 외교적 노력을 지속해 나갈 것이라고 밝혔다.)

At this meeting, the officials comprehensively reviewed the preservation and management status of Korea's independence movement historical sites in China based on the on-site inspection results of overseas missions. In particular, given that more than 80 years have passed since liberation, making the preservation of these sites in China increasingly important, they focused on discussing ways to strengthen the institutionalization of preservation and management of historical sites between Korea and China, while also discussing measures to revitalize exchanges between the Korean and Chinese people by expanding the use of the provisional government buildings in Shanghai and Chongqing. ( 이번 회의에서 담당관들은 재외공관의 현장점검 결과를 바탕으로 중국 내 우리 독립운동 사적지의 보존·관리 현황을 종합적으로 점검했다. 특히, 광복 이후 80년 이상이 지나 중국 내 사적지들의 보존 문제가 중요해진 상황에서 한중간 사적지 보존ㆍ관리의 제도화 강화 방안을 중점 논의하는 한편, 상하이 및 충칭 임정 청사 활용 확대 등을 통해 한중 양국 국민 간 교류를 활성화하는 방안도 논의하였다.)

Park Min-hee, Senior Staff Reporter minggu@hani.co.kr ( 박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Applications Open for 'Vietnam Binh Hoa Massacre Memorial Tour' Co-Hosted by People's Solidarity for Participatory Democracy and Others (참여연대 등 공동주최 ‘베트남 빈호아 학살 기행단’ 모집)
item.description:
Civic groups are jointly organizing a peace tour to visit Vietnam in commemoration of the 60th anniversary of the Binh Hoa massacre victims this year. (올해 60주기를 맞는 베트남 빈호아 학살 희생자를 추모하기 위해 시민단체들이 공동으로 평화기행단을 조직해 현지를 방문한다.)

The Korea-Vietnam Peace Foundation (Chairman Kang Woo-il) announced that it is "recruiting participants for the '60th Anniversary of the Binh Hoa Massacre 60-Person Citizens' Peace Tour,' co-hosted by the Institute for Korean Historical Studies, the Citizens' Peace Forum, and People's Solidarity for Participatory Democracy, and organized by the foundation." Binh Hoa village in Binh Trung commune, Quang Ngai Province (formerly Binh Hoa commune, Binh Son district) is where 430 people were massacred by the South Korean Army's Blue Dragon Brigade in December 1966 during the Vietnam War, and a monument of hatred against the South Korean military stands at the village entrance. <<> The schedule runs from November 30 to December 4, spanning 5 days and 4 nights. On December 2, participants will attend the 60th anniversary memorial ceremony for the Binh Hoa massacre hosted by the local People's Committee, offering respects and laying flowers, and will have a meeting with village residents. Other activities include visits to the Da Nang Museum and the My Lai Museum, as well as paying respects at the memorial steles in Phong Nhi and Ha My, other affected areas. Applications for 60 participants will be accepted on a first-come, first-served basis until the 13th of next month, with a participation fee of 1.7 million won. (한베평화재단(이사장 강우일)은 “민족문제연구소·시민평화포럼·참여연대 공동주최 및 재단 주관으로 ‘빈호아 학살 60주기 60인 시민평화기행’ 참가자를 모집한다”고 밝혔다. 꽝응아이성 반뜨엉사 빈호아 마을(옛 빈선현 빈호아사)은 베트남전 시기인 1966년 12월 한국군 청룡부대에 의해 430명이 떼죽음을 당한 곳으로, 마을 입구에 한국군 증오비가 세워져 있다.)

The Korea-Vietnam Peace Foundation explained, "This tour is a journey of remembrance and solidarity to honor the 430 victims and stand with the surviving victims," adding, "A portion of the participation fee will be donated as support for the Binh Hoa memorial ceremony to convey a message of peace." (일정은 11월30일부터 12월4일까지 4박5일이다. 12월2일엔 현지 인민위원회 주최로 열리는 빈호아 학살 60주기 위령제에 참여해 참배 및 헌화하고 마을 주민들과 만남의 자리를 갖는다. 그 밖에도 다낭박물관·밀라이박물관 탐방과 또 다른 피해 지역인 퐁니 및 하미 위령비 참배 등이 있다. 다음 달 13일까지 60명을 선착순 모집하며, 참가비는 170만원이다.)

Application and details: https://nuli.do/bh60_jjn. (한베평화재단은 “이번 기행은 430명의 희생자를 기억하고 피해생존자와 함께하는 추모와 연대의 여정”이라며 “참가비의 일부는 빈호아 위령제 지원금으로 평화의 마음을 전할 예정”이라고 설명했다.)

Inquiries: kovietpeace@gmail.com, 02-2295-2016. (신청 및 안내 https://nuli.do/bh60_jjn.)

item.title: Steel Ambassador's 'Hotteok Shot' at Namdaemun Market and Service at Youngnak Church... Moves Highlighting Affinity (스틸 대사, 남대문시장 ‘호떡샷’·영락교회 예배…친밀감 부각 행보)
item.description:
Newly appointed U.S. Ambassador to South Korea Michelle Steel spent her first weekend in office visiting Namdaemun Market in Jung-gu, Seoul, and attending a church service. The moves are seen as an effort to emphasize emotional bonds and closeness with the Korean people. (미셸 스틸 신임 주한미국대사가 부임 뒤 첫 주말을 맞아 서울 중구 남대문시장을 찾고, 교회 예배에 참석했다. 한국민과의 정서적 유대감과 친밀감을 부각하는 행보로 풀이된다.)

On Sunday, the 2nd, Ambassador Steel attended a service at Youngnak Church in Jung-gu, Seoul, with her husband, attorney Sean Steel. Arriving at the church in a diplomatic vehicle, she was introduced by church officials after the service and stood from her seat to greet congregants with clasped hands. (스틸 대사는 일요일인 2일 남편인 숀 스틸 변호사와 서울 중구 영락교회 예배에 참석했다. 외교관 차량으로 교회에 도착한 그는 예배 뒤 교회 쪽의 소개를 받고 좌석에서 일어나 교인들에게 손을 모으며 인사했다.)

Ambassador Steel, the first Korean-American female U.S. ambassador to South Korea, took office on July 30. Born in Seoul in 1955, she left Korea with her parents after graduating elementary school and moved to the United States in 1975. Youngnak Church was founded by North Korean refugees during the Korean War. Ambassador Steel's parents were displaced people who fled North Korea during the war, and it is known that they attended this church before emigrating. On her first day in office, Ambassador Steel also visited Youngnak Church and wrote in the guestbook in English, "I am very happy to begin my new journey in Korea with prayer. I am a blessed person to be here." (스틸 대사는 한국계 첫 여성 주한미국대사로 7월30일 부임했다. 1955년 서울에서 태어난 그는 초등학교 졸업 뒤 부모를 따라 한국을 떠나 1975년 미국으로 건너갔다. 영락교회는 북한 실향민들이 한국전쟁 때 세운 교회다. 스틸 대사의 부모는 한국전쟁 때 북한을 떠나온 실향민으로, 이민 전까지 이 교회를 다닌 것으로 전해졌다. 스틸 대사는 부임 첫날에도 영락교회를 찾아 방명록에 영문으로 “한국에서의 새 여정을 기도로 시작하게 돼 매우 행복하다. 여기 있는 나는 축복받은 사람”이라고 썼다.)

On the 1st, Ambassador Steel also posted four photos taken at Namdaemun Market on her X (formerly Twitter) account. The photos show her wearing a white T-shirt commemorating the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States while holding hotteok, and posing with her husband, Attorney Steel, making a finger heart with Sungnyemun Gate in the background. She also told the hotteok shop owner, "I'm a grandmother too. I have four grandchildren." Ambassador Steel wrote on X in both Korean and English, "Returning to Namdaemun Market after a long time brought back old memories," adding, "Many things have changed, but the warm affection, vitality, and familiar scenery were just as I remembered." (스틸 대사는 지난 1일엔 자신의 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 남대문시장에서 찍은 사진 4장을 올리기도 했다. 사진에는 미국 건국 250주년을 기념하는 흰 티셔츠를 입고 호떡을 든 모습과 남편 스틸 변호사와 숭례문을 배경으로 손 하트를 한 모습 등이 담겼다. 그는 호떡집 주인에게 “저도 할머니다. 손주가 넷 있다”고 말하기도 했다. 스틸 대사는 엑스에 한국어와 영어로 “오랜만에 다시 찾은 남대문시장에서 옛 추억이 새록새록 떠올랐다”며 “많은 것이 변했지만, 따뜻한 정과 활기, 정겨운 풍경은 기억 속 모습 그대로였다”고 썼다.)

On the 31st, she posted a photo taken with the U.S. Embassy building and the statue of King Sejong in the background, writing, "Passing by the statue of King Sejong, I was reminded once again of Korea's legacy of outstanding innovation and leadership. I look forward to the journey we will embark on together." (지난 31일엔 주한미국대사관 건물과 세종대왕 동상을 배경으로 찍은 사진을 올리며 “세종대왕 동상을 지나며 한국의 뛰어난 혁신과 리더십의 유산을 다시금 떠올렸다. 여러분과 만들어갈 여정이 기대된다”고 적었다.)

Ambassador Steel faces the task of coordinating major issues between South Korea and the United States, including investment in the U.S. and tariff issues, trade matters involving Coupang, and uranium enrichment and reprocessing. (스틸 대사는 대미 투자와 관세 문제, 쿠팡을 포함한 통상 문제, 우라늄 농축·재처리 문제 등 한·미 양국 간 굵직한 현안을 조율해야 하는 과제를 안고 있다.)

item.title: Kwak Sang-eon: "Former President Roh Moo-hyun Never Pursued Complete Abolition of Prosecution's Investigative Powers" (곽상언 “노무현 전 대통령, 검수완박 추진한 적 없다”)
item.description:
Kwak Sang-eon, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea and son-in-law of the late former President Roh Moo-hyun, voted against the amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act that entirely abolishes prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers and direct investigative authority, and subsequently stated, "President Roh Moo-hyun never pursued completely stripping the prosecution of its investigative powers to give the police exclusive investigative authority." (‘노무현 사위’ 곽상언 더불어민주당 의원이 검사의 보완수사권을 비롯한 직접 수사 권한을 전면 폐지하는 형사소송법 개정안에 반대표를 던진 데 이어 “노무현 대통령은 검찰의 수사권을 완전히 박탈해서 경찰이 독점적 수사권을 갖도록 추진한 적이 없다”고 말했다.)

On the 2nd, Rep. Kwak wrote on Facebook, "Since the Criminal Procedure Act abolishing the prosecution's investigative powers passed, many politicians have once again invoked President Roh Moo-hyun's politics, the Roh Moo-hyun spirit, and even President Roh Moo-hyun's death," adding the aforementioned remarks. (곽 의원은 2일 페이스북에 “검찰의 수사권을 폐지하는 형사소송법이 통과된 직후부터, 많은 정치인이 노무현 대통령의 정치와 노무현 정신, 심지어 노무현 대통령의 죽음을 또다시 소환하고 있다”며 이렇게 말했다.)

He continued, "Their argument (that the prosecution's investigative powers should be completely abolished) is entirely different from President Roh Moo-hyun's intentions or his politics." In this regard, Rep. Kwak cited examples including Rep. Jeong Cheong-rae's statement that "Separating investigation from indictment and stopping the prosecutor's republic from running amok was former President Roh Moo-hyun's unfinished dream and a calling of the times. Dismantling the omnipotent power concentrated in the prosecution is the completion of the Roh Moo-hyun spirit," along with Rep. Kim Yong-min's visit to Bongha Village. He also mentioned Rep. Kim Min-seok's remark that "I humbly dedicate the reform bills that passed through the National Assembly today to the memory of President Roh Moo-hyun." <<> Rep. Kwak reiterated, "President Roh Moo-hyun never pursued the so-called 'complete abolition of prosecution investigative powers' during his tenure," and said, "He pursued an adjustment of investigative powers in a direction that recognized the independence of police investigations, limited to certain public safety and livelihood crimes, on the premise of judicial control by the prosecution." He added, "President Roh also rebuked the police's demands for the complete abolition of prosecutors' investigative command authority and the granting of exclusive authority to the police to close investigations," and "President Roh clearly warned against not only prosecutorial power but also the police's unilateral assertion of power." <<> Rep. Kwak said, "Many politicians are distorting things President Roh never said as if they were his words, pursuing their own political interests and deceiving the people," and "They are making the public perceive President Roh only as a 'victim of prosecutorial abuse of investigative powers,' misleading the public so they cannot see the true nature of the politics Roh actually pursued." <<> Earlier, on the 31st of last month, the amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act, which entirely abolishes prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers and direct investigative authority, passed the National Assembly plenary session led by the ruling party. The amendment takes effect on October 2, when the prosecution service is abolished and the Serious Crimes Investigation Office and the Public Prosecution Office are launched. The criminal justice system, which has continued for over 70 years since the enactment of the Criminal Procedure Act in 1954, is facing a major turning point. <<> In the plenary vote, held with lawmakers of the People Power Party absent, 175 of the 178 lawmakers present voted in favor, 2 opposed, and 1 abstained. Rep. Kwak was the only Democratic Party lawmaker to vote against. <<> Reporter Ha Eo-young haha@hani.co.kr (이어 그는 “(검찰 수사권을 완전히 박탈해야 한다는) 이들의 주장은 노무현 대통령의 뜻이나 정치와 전혀 다르다”고 했다. 곽 의원은 이와 관련해 정청래 의원이 “검찰공화국의 폭주를 막고 수사와 기소를 분리하는 것은 노무현 전 대통령의 못다 이룬 꿈이자 시대적 소명이다. 검찰에 집약된 전능한 권력을 해체하는 것이야말로 노무현 정신의 완성”이라고 말한 사례와 함께 김용민 의원이 봉하마을을 방문한 사실을 들었다. 또한 김민석 의원이 “오늘 국회 문턱을 넘은 개혁법안을 노무현 대통령 영전에 고이 바친다”는 발언을 한 것도 언급했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "Whose side was Kim Min-seok on in 2002?" Kim Min-seok: "Thank you for embracing the prodigal son who has returned" (정청래 “2002년 김민석은 누구 편” 김민석 “돌아온 탕아 안아주셔”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, a candidate for the party leader in the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention, and candidate Kim Min-seok clashed over support from pro-Roh (pro-Roh Moo-hyun) voters on the 2nd during the Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang regional primary, referencing Kim's actions during the 2002 presidential election candidate unification between Roh Moo-hyun and Chung Mong-joon. (정청래 더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 대표 후보와 김민석 후보가 2일 부·울·경(부산·울산·경남) 순회경선에서 과거 2002년 대선 당시 노무현·정몽준 후보 단일화 당시 김 후보의 행보를 언급하며 친노 표심을 두고 격돌했다.)

At a joint rally held at BEXCO in Busan that day, Jung asked, "Do you remember the night when the Chosun Ilbo editorial said 'Chung Mong-joon abandoned Roh Moo-hyun,' and we were frantically sending texts and making calls? Whose side was Kim Min-seok on that night?" He added, "The late President Roh said, 'Do you want to be treated like a human being? Then you must have loyalty.'" He continued, "Four years ago, Rep. Kim Min-seok blamed Lee Jae-myung for the defeat in the local elections and attacked him, saying he ruined them because of his personal judgment. Now, four years later, he is attacking Jung Cheong-rae." Jung also said, "Once a betrayer, always a betrayer." <<> In response, Kim said, "The late President Kim Dae-jung, after the candidate unification in 2002, gave me a parting instruction: 'Cultivate your inner strength.'" He added, "Former Rep. Seo Gap-won, who knows the candidate unification process, is now helping me. Regarding what Kim Min-seok, who was not part of the candidate unification committee, did in 2002, he told me that when I visited Bongha Village as a supreme council member in 2008, President Roh said, 'The choice of the delegates has brought historical closure.'" Kim also said, "You made me realize that the power of the people and collective intelligence are the true foundation of politics, and you have criticized me for 24 years. I bow my head and express my deep gratitude." <<> He said, "I say this to Busan and the Democratic Party, who are embracing the prodigal son who has returned," adding, "The son of the Democratic Party, the rightful heir of the Democratic Party, has come back." <<> Song Young-gil, a candidate for party leader, speaking about the situation on the night before the 2002 presidential election when Chung Mong-joon withdrew his support, said, "I persuaded the late President Roh and took him to Chung Mong-joon's house in Seodaemun, and we were turned away at the door." He added, "All the people who watched that footage were outraged, and a miracle happened. I am the candidate to protect the 'second Roh Moo-hyun,' Lee Jae-myung, and the frontrunner for regime renewal, Song Young-gil." <<> Reporter Ha Eo-young haha@hani.co.kr ( 정 후보는 이날 부산 벡스코에서 열린 합동연설회에서 “조선일보 사설에서 ‘정몽준이 노무현을 버렸다’고 했을 때 발을 동동 구르며 문자를 보내고 전화했던 밤을 기억하느냐. 그 날 밤 김민석은 누구 편이었느냐”고 물었다. 이어 “노 전 대통령께서 ‘사람대접받고 싶은가, 그러면 의리가 있어야 한다’라고 했다”며 “4년 전 지방선거 패배 책임을 이재명에게 돌리고 이재명의 사적 판단 때문에 지방선거를 망쳤다고 공격했던 김민석 의원이 4년 후에는 정청래를 공격하고 있다”고 말했다. 또한 정 후보는 “한 번 배신하면 또 배신할 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee to Resume Departmental Briefings on the 4th and 5th (이 대통령 4일∼5일 부처별 업무보고 재개)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, who returns on the 3rd after concluding his U.S. and South America tour, will resume departmental briefings. (미국·남미 순방 일정을 마무리하고 3일 귀국하는 이재명 대통령이 부처별 업무보고를 재개한다.)

The presidential office said on the 2nd that President Lee will receive briefings from 27 ministries, offices, and agencies on the 4th and 5th. On the 4th, starting at 2 p.m., briefings will be held for the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, the Intellectual Property Office, the Ministry of Climate and Energy, the Korea Meteorological Administration, and the Nuclear Safety and Security Commission. At 4:20 p.m. the same day, the Ministry of Employment and Labor, the Ministry of SMEs and Startups, and the Fair Trade Commission will present their briefings. Plans from each ministry to support the three major mega-projects are expected to be key agenda items. (청와대는 이 대통령이 4∼5일 부·처·청 27곳으로부터 업무보고를 받는다고 2일 밝혔다. 4일에는 오후 2시부터 산업자원통상부·지식재산처·기후에너지부·기상청·원자력안전위원회를 대상으로 한 업무보고가 진행된다. 같은 날 오후 4시20분부터는 고용노동부·중소벤처기업부·공정거래위원회가 업무보고를 한다. 3대 메가프로젝트를 뒷받침하기 위한 부처별 계획이 주요 안건으로 다뤄질 것으로 전망된다.)

On the 5th, briefings are scheduled for the full day. From 10 a.m., the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Overseas Koreans Agency, the Ministry of Unification, the Ministry of National Defense, the Military Manpower Administration, the Defense Acquisition Program Administration, and the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs will present. Then, from 2 p.m., the Ministry of Education, the National Education Commission, the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, and the Korea Heritage Service will follow, and from 4:20 p.m., briefings will be held for the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, the National Police Agency, the National Fire Agency, the Personnel Management Innovation Office, the Ministry of Justice, the Supreme Prosecutors' Office, the Ministry of Government Legislation, and the Office for Government Policy Coordination. In the foreign affairs and security briefings, attention is on whether issues such as contributions to stabilizing the Strait of Hormuz, the U.S.-Korea nuclear agreement, and the construction of nuclear-powered submarines will be addressed. In the briefings for the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, the Ministry of Justice, and the Supreme Prosecutors' Office, follow-up measures regarding the amendment of the Criminal Procedure Act, which strips prosecutors of their direct investigation powers, are expected to be discussed. (5일에는 종일 업무보고가 예정돼 있다. 오전 10시부터 외교부·재외동포청·통일부·국방부·병무청·방위사업청·국가보훈부가 업무보고를 한다. 이어 오후 2시부터 교육부·국가교육위원회·문화체육관광부·국가유산청이, 오후 4시20분부터는 행정안전부·경찰청·소방청·인사혁신처·법무부·검찰청·법제처·국무조정실 업무보고가 진행된다. 외교·안보 부처 업무보고에선 호르무즈 해협 안정을 위한 기여 방안, 한-미 원자력 협정, 핵추진잠수함 건조 등의 현안이 다뤄질지 주목된다. 행안부와 법무부, 검찰청 등의 업무보고에선 검찰 직접 수사권 박탈을 골자로 한 형사소송법 개정에 따른 후속 조처가 논의될 것으로 예상된다.)

item.title: Ruling party focuses on publicizing criminal procedure law… Opposition pushes constitutional petition, calls for veto (여, 형소법 국민 홍보 집중…야, 헌법소원 추진·거부권 촉구)
item.description:
After the criminal procedure law amendment centered on abolishing prosecutors' supplementary investigation authority passed the National Assembly threshold, the Democratic Party of Korea has been concentrating its efforts on public opinion campaigns day after day, seeking to minimize public backlash. The People Power Party is escalating its offensive, demanding President Lee Jae-myung exercise his right to request reconsideration (veto) and initiating constitutional petition procedures. (검사의 보완수사권 폐지를 뼈대로 하는 형사소송법 개정안이 국회 문턱을 넘은 뒤 더불어민주당은 연일 여론전에 당력을 집중하며 민심 이반을 최소화하려는 모습이다. 국민의힘은 이재명 대통령의 재의요구권(거부권) 행사를 요구하고 헌법소원 절차에 나서는 등 공세 수위를 높이고 있다.)

The Democratic Party plans to hold a national report session on the criminal procedure law at the National Assembly on the 3rd. Key party figures who led the amendment, including Acting Representative and Floor Leader Han Byung-do, Policy Committee Chair Han Jung-ae, and Deputy Floor Leader for Policy Kim Han-kyu, will attend. Floor Leader Han previously stated at a supreme council meeting on the 31st of last month, "We will report to the people in detail on what changes, how it changes, and what follow-up measures will be pursued." The Democratic Party is also preparing to establish an internal body to strengthen the rights of crime victims. (민주당은 3일 국회에서 형사소송법 대국민 보고회를 열 예정이다. 한병도 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표, 한정애 정책위의장, 김한규 원내정책수석부대표 등 형사소송법 개정을 주도한 당 핵심 인사들이 참석한다. 한 원내대표는 지난달 31일 최고위원회의에서 “무엇이 어떻게 달라지는지, 어떤 후속조처를 추진할 것인지 상세히 국민께 보고할 예정”이라고 말한 바 있다. 민주당은 범죄 피해자 권익 강화를 위한 당내 기구 설치도 준비 중이다.)

Regarding the introduction of the "mandatory transfer of all seven major crimes" to block side effects of abolishing supplementary investigation authority, the party's position is to complete legislative supplementation before the National Assembly audit in October. The Democratic Party, concerned about weakened investigations due to the abolition, has decided to introduce a system where all cases investigated by primary investigative agencies such as police—without exception—are transferred to prosecutors for seven major crimes: child abuse, domestic violence, sexual crimes, child sexual crimes, stalking, abuse of persons with disabilities, and elder abuse. Rep. Kim Seung-won, the ruling party secretary on the National Assembly Legislation and Judiciary Committee, held a press conference with Committee Chair Seo Young-kyo at the Assembly on the 2nd and stated, "There is no problem at all in implementing the laws on October 2 (when the prosecution service launches)." Chair Seo emphasized, "The criminal procedure law amendment is a much improved criminal procedure law," adding, "The most important thing is to strengthen checks and mutual cooperation (between investigative and prosecution agencies), provide robust protection for victims, and catch criminals to the end." (보완수사권 폐지 부작용 차단을 위한 ‘7대 범죄 전건송치’ 도입과 관련해선, 오는 10월 국정감사 전 입법 보완을 마무리하겠다는 방침이다. 민주당은 보완수사권 폐지로 인한 수사 약화 우려에 아동 학대, 가정폭력, 성범죄, 아동 성범죄, 스토킹, 장애인 학대, 노인 학대 등 7대 범죄에 한해 경찰 등 1차 수사기관이 수사한 모든 사건을 예외 없이 검찰에 넘기는 전건송치 제도를 도입하기로 한 바 있다. 국회 법제사법위원회 여당 간사인 김승원 의원은 2일 국회에서 서영교 법사위원장과 함께 기자간담회를 열어 “(공소청이 출범하는) 10월2일 법률들을 시행하는 데 전혀 지장이 없다”고 말했다. 서 위원장은 “(형사소송법 개정안은) 훨씬 더 좋아진 형사소송법”이라며 “제일 중요한 건 (수사기관과 공소기관의) 견제와 상호 협력, 피해자의 보호를 두텁게 하고 범죄자는 끝까지 잡는 것”이라고 강조했다.)

The People Power Party has announced it will file a constitutional petition against the criminal procedure law amendment. Floor Leader Chung Jeom-sik wrote on Facebook that day, "The presidential office and the Democratic Party may be celebrating ahead of concluding a political backroom deal swapping the abolition of supplementary investigation authority for dismissal of prosecution, but this criminal procedure law amendment is rife with unconstitutionality," adding, "We will pursue the normalization of the judiciary in South Korea through a constitutional petition." On the 3rd, the party will hold an on-site supreme council meeting in front of the presidential office (Yongsan) and urge President Lee to exercise his right to request reconsideration. (국민의힘은 형사소송법 개정안에 대한 헌법소원 심판 청구를 예고했다. 정점식 원내대표는 이날 페이스북에 “청와대와 민주당은 보완수사권 폐지와 공소기각을 맞교환하는 정치적 이면 계약 성사를 앞두고 환호작약하고 있겠지만, 이번 형사소송법 개정안은 위헌성이 농후하다”며 “헌법소원 심판 청구를 통해 대한민국 사법 정상화에 나서겠다”고 했다. 3일에는 청와대 앞에서 현장 최고위원회의를 열고 이 대통령의 재의요구권 행사를 촉구한다.)

Under the Constitution, the president must promulgate a bill passed by the National Assembly plenary session within 15 days of its transfer to the government. The criminal procedure law amendment is expected to be submitted and approved at a Cabinet meeting as early as the 4th or the 11th, followed by promulgation. (헌법에 따라 대통령은 국회 본회의를 통과한 법안이 정부로 이송된 지 15일 안에 공포해야 한다. 형사소송법 개정안은 이르면 4일 또는 11일 국무회의에서 상정·의결된 뒤 공포될 전망이다.)

item.title: Top Committee Members: 'Pro-Myung 3, Pro-Chung 2'... Tight Race for Winning Seats in Chungcheong and Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam Primaries (최고위원 ‘친명 3·친청 2명’…충청·부울경 경선 당선권 접전)
item.description:
In the regional primaries for the Supreme Council members held on the 1st and 2nd in the Chungcheong region and Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam (Busan, Ulsan, South Gyeongsang) for the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 party convention, pro-Chung (pro-Chung Chung-rae) candidates, backed by support from traditional party members, and pro-Myung (pro-Lee Jae-myung) candidates, leveraging their name recognition, engaged in a tight race within the winning zone. With securing a majority being essential to lead the decision-making in the Supreme Council meeting within the nine-member new leadership, strategic vote battles between factions to win at least two of the five elected Supreme Council seats are expected to intensify further. <<> Summing up the results of the Chungcheong region (Daejeon, Sejong, South Chungcheong, North Chungcheong) and Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam Supreme Council regional primaries announced by the party's election management committee on the 1st and 2nd respectively, the votes were cast in the following order: Choi Min-hee (22.58%, 55,080 votes), Park Sun-won (16.41%, 40,038 votes), Han Min-soo (14.46%, 35,282 votes), Seo Mi-hwa (13.72%, 33,478 votes), Kim Yong (12.41%, 30,277 votes), Lee Sung-yoon (11.34%, 27,654 votes), Lim Mi-ae (5.73%, 13,991 votes), and Kim Young-ho (3.35%, 8,162 votes). The Supreme Council election is conducted using a combined voting method where each voter selects two candidates at once. However, in accordance with the party's policy to add a weight of 5% to votes in strategic regions where party support is weak (Daegu, North Gyeongsang, South Gyeongsang), a 5% bonus will be added to the South Gyeongsang regional results when the final results are tallied on the 17th. <<> By faction, the pro-Chung camp (candidates Choi Min-hee, Han Min-soo, Lee Sung-yoon) is evaluated as having performed well. Candidate Choi secured a comfortable first place as the only one to exceed 20%, and candidate Han also ranked third, placing within the winning zone (1st-5th). For the pro-Myung camp, candidate Park ranked second with high name recognition, and candidates Seo Mi-hwa and Kim Yong also made the top five, placing three members in total within the winning zone. However, the vote difference between 5th-place candidate Kim Yong and 6th-place pro-Chung candidate Lee is only about 2,600 votes. <<> With the early structure of the regional primaries becoming somewhat apparent, there are predictions within the party that factional calculations will become increasingly complex until the final results are announced on the 17th. Tensions between the two sides are also heating up further. <<> A lawmaker assisting party leader candidate Kim Min-seok told the Hankyoreh, "Isn't it the case that an order was issued to Chung Chung-rae supporters to 'push Choi Min-hee as the first choice for Supreme Council member by all means'? This kind of ticket-splitting voting, which is not fitting for party member sovereignty, is a violation of election law," sharpening his tone. In contrast, a source close to Chung Chung-rae said, "In the end, it's a 3 vs. 2 fight. From next week, the pro-Myung camp will also engage in strategic voting to filter out 'the 2 to be dropped' among the 5 pro-Myung candidates." They added, "With the contours of two likely winning candidates per faction becoming clear, the 'battle for 5th place' will intensify from now on." <<> Kim Chae-woon, Reporter cwk@hani.co.kr Ko Han-sol, Reporter sol@hani.co.kr (지난 1~2일 충청권과 부·울·경(부산·울산·경남)에서 치른 더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 최고위원 순회경선에서는 전통적 당원들의 지지세를 등에 업은 친청계(친정청래계) 후보들과 인지도를 앞세운 친명계(친이재명계) 후보들이 당선권 안에서 접전을 벌였다. 9명으로 구성되는 새 지도부에서 최고위원회의 의결을 주도하려면 과반 확보가 필수인 만큼, 선출직 최고위원 5명 중 최소 2명 당선을 위한 계파별 투표 전략 수싸움이 더욱 치열해질 것으로 보인다.)
